player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Sachmo''') posted a [[Light]] [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|Mind What You Have Learned]] list on DeckTech in June 2001.

starting.card: Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can

description: Classic Jedi Test to 6 deck with a little bit of old school droid retrieval tech.
cards: Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can
It Is The Future You See
shields_note: The post names no Defensive Shields.
notes: Posted 28 June 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted (marked '(s)'): Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can, Dagobah, Heading For The Medical Frigate, Your Insight Serves You Well, Battle Plan and The Way Of Things; these count toward the 60. Your Insight Serves You Well is shown as the starting effect.
Total as published is 63, not 60 (counting the six Jedi Tests and both Dagobah sites from the 'Jungle Swamp' line).

Posted 'Jungle Swamp' (one line, no quantity) dested Dagobah: Jungle and Dagobah: Swamp, one each; the same author's later version of this deck (Simply the Way of Things v2.0) lists 'Jungle' and 'Swamp' on separate lines.
Posted 'Jedi Tests #1-6' dested the six Jedi Tests: Great Warrior, A Jedi's Strength, Domain Of Evil, Size Matters Not, It Is The Future You See, You Must Confront Vader.
Posted 'CC Incinerator x2' dested the Light Cloud City: Incinerator; 'Dagobah' dested Dagobah (Light).

Posted 'EPP Obi' / 'EPP Luke' / 'EPP Han' dested Obi-Wan With Lightsaber, Luke With Lightsaber and Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol; 'DOS' dested Daughter Of Skywalker; 'EG-4' dested EG-4 (Eegee-Four); 'Intruder Missle' Intruder Missile.

Posted 'OOC' dested Out Of Commission; 'OOC/TT' Out Of Commission & Transmission Terminated; 'HFTMF' Heading For The Medical Frigate; 'YISYW' Your Insight Serves You Well; 'BP' Battle Plan; 'AFA' Anger, Fear, Aggression; 'HotJ' Honor Of The Jedi; 'DtF' Draw Their Fire.
Wise Advice is the Special Edition Effect (an Effect, not a Defensive Shield, in 2001).
